history.summary: FLAG - AMBIGUOUS IDENTITY: the CSV row 'Ashapura Mata Temple, Rajkot' has no documented single referent. Several Ashapura shrines exist in Rajkot (Palace Road/Prahlad Plot, Nanamova Road, Vavdi, Thebachada Road) and the famous state shrine is at Mata no Madh, Kutch. This file documents the most-reviewed in-city shrine: Ashapura Mata Mandir on Palace Road, Prahlad Plot (Rajkot 360001), per Justdial listings and geocode (22.29367, 70.80804). Its antiquity, builder and trust history are undocumented. Media is empty because no reliable image of this specific shrine was found.

name: Ashapura Mata Mandir, Prahlad Plot (Palace Road), Rajkot
town_description: Rajkot is the largest city in Gujarat's Saurashtra region and a former princely state capital; Mahatma Gandhi spent part of his early life here, and it is now a major commercial and industrial hub.

travel.airport: Hirasar Rajkot International Airport (~36 km) is the main airport.
travel.railway: Rajkot Junction is ~2-3 km from Prahlad Plot.
travel.road: In central Rajkot on Palace Road, Prahlad Plot; reached by auto or city bus.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Listings conflict (verify): Prahlad Plot shrine 5:00 AM-9:00 PM vs 7:00 AM-1:00 PM; Nanamova Road shrine 6:00 AM-8:00 PM.
